name: Amazon Titan Text Premier
description: Amazon's most capable proprietary LLM for enterprise text generation.
longDescription: Amazon Titan Text Premier is Amazon's flagship proprietary large language model, optimized for enterprise workloads on AWS Bedrock. It excels at complex text generation, summarization, RAG-based Q&A, and multi-turn conversation, with built-in safety features and AWS integration.
limitations: Less capable than GPT-4 class models

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import boto3
import json

client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId="amazon.titan-text-premier-v1:0",
    body=json.dumps({"inputText": "Hello!", "textGenerationConfig": {"maxTokenCount": 512}})
)
result = json.loads(response["body"].read())
print(result["results"][0]["outputText"])
